parameters: "Oh hey, it looks like the sign and the place got updated again !"
"Finally this place isn't gonna be boring and bland !!"
"Wait is the sign still all scribbles ?"
"Yeah it is still just all scribbles."
"I swear whoever is writing these never bother to make it semi readable"
"Oh well, I'll get used to it soon"
"Lemme read what this says really quick"
"'What's that? There's been another update to this testing room?'"
"'Wow, look who has two eyes and an body that can read!'"
"What kind of wizard magic are they using to find this info on me ..."
"'Welcome to the 1.4 version of the testing room Smoll Boi!'"
"'If you look to the right of me you will see this tall sign post thingy.'"
"'These are what the checkpoints look like!'"
"'If you pass by one and then later die in a level you'll be brought here.'"
"'So whenever you see one make sure to pass by it to activate it.'"
"'And to the left of you is where some platforms are at.'"

"'Test out the movement on these!
Like your jumping, double jumping, and sprinting.'"
"'Also if you're wondering if the wall jumping works then I have some bad news.'"
"'A guy has tried many times to make it work and it's not letting him code it in because it's mean.'"
"'The bushwoots and the guy are currently working together to make it work but who knows how long that's going to take!'"
"'So enjoy this mini testing area and play around with the controls!'"
"'Written by the only bushwoot that's a wizard while being the only one to write'"
"I wanna be a wizard that can write too !!"
"Darn wizards having cool powers and spells"
"With their cool wizards outfits and magic wands ..."
"Being super cool while shouting the names of there spells ..."
"Man I'd bet that being a wizard is so cool ..."
"Oh right the testing room or area or whatever you call it"
"'Hey, for record this is still just a work in progress testing area...'"
"'Almost everthing here has a placeholder sprite because it hasn't been made yet!'"
"'And their might be glitches in this too because the guy making this is still learning how to do all of this in the handful of free time they have!'"
"'Anyways, one thing that has been coded in is the dash move.'"
"'If it works correctly you can now do a dash by pressing X but while dashing you can press Z to do a dash jump.'"
"'The dash jump will make you do a sizeable leap with your current speed you have to make you go futher.'"
"Please help my entire body is in black and white."
"Why is he in black and white .."

"Oh you know!!
you said what's up and I said the sun because if you look up you'll see sun there ..."
"Dude, that was the lamest joke you could of ever do responding to that..."
"What are you two doing up here !"
"Still kinda waiting for me to be apart of the game you know..."
"What are we even supposed to do to help you dude."
"Yeah, like do you want us to call 911 or like"
